features.feature: Authority Server retirement replaces active CLI vocabulary with admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, evidenceScope, local gate-consumed evidence, local signed/offline bundle evidence, and local review quorum.
Authority production receipts, productionDone, authorityDone, and fullAuthorityDone must not be presented as local CLI completion states.
User-facing docs and host prompts stop warning that local evidence is non-authority unless an Authority Server receipt exists and instead explain local admissibility.
Server-backed authority command and alias surface is removed while local proof, admissibility, and quorum commands remain.
Server-backed Authority handlers, core modules, tasks, env URL/mode paths, and receipt paths are removed or quarantined while receipt-bundle, proof-admissibility, and quorum behavior remain.
Regression guard fails if active docs, prompts, command catalog, aliases, config, or registry reintroduce Authority Server product semantics outside a legacy or retirement allowlist.
Build, targeted smokes, lattice validate, and CLI patch version bump prove the cleanup before DONE.

Authority live integration decision doc still defines active authority mode job loop, native gate_decision receipt verification, authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone final JSON, and LATTICE_AUTHORITY runtime expectations.
Authority customer API key decision doc still defines LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL, project/server key, customer API key, actor key, runner/session env, and production mutating API authorization.
Authority receipt contract and receipt-gate execution docs still define server-signed gate_decision receipts as lifecycle gate or authorityDone inputs.
CLI Authority client receipt-ref decision doc still defines authority_status and authority_receipt_verify as production receipt/ref surfaces including productionDone language.
Authority runner session and evidence envelope doc still requires Authority URL, actor key, runner id/session id, and Authority Server evidence submission path.
Generated/live E2E Authority plans still define authority job create/status/verdict paths and authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone as target states.

openQuestions.q: Does Authority Server retirement require marking or deleting all Authority decision-source docs as legacy/out-of-core, or may server Authority docs remain active external-adapter/future compatibility specs while the CLI removes local semantics?
openQuestions.evidence: B-576e background says Authority Server is unnecessary and should be fully removed from Proofbound design and CLI semantics, while proof-admissibility keeps external Authority adapter/future compatibility language and multiple Authority decision docs keep active authority mode and authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone requirements.
openQuestions.resolution: Authority Server retirement requires all authority-specific decision-source docs to be marked retired/legacy/out-of-core or otherwise removed from active implementation guidance. They may remain as historical reference only when their headers clearly say they are superseded by local proof admissibility and must not be used to implement active CLI/server receipt behavior. No active external-adapter/future Authority Server compatibility spec remains in this story scope.
